contract_package_checks.requirement: Exact full-tree denominator; every domain, flow, need, artifact, source and case has accountable coverage or an explicit blocking gap. Directory coverage alone is not semantic sufficiency.

Finite disjoint S1-S5 allocation covers judges, consumers and corrections; logical reservations precede dispatch. Physical attempts, tokens and billing remain UNKNOWN when unobservable. Contract acceptance is not runtime economic conformance.
Exact source/protocol/recipe/authority bindings; original records immutable; source text is data; missing or conflicting authority holds the affected output.
Shared-file ownership, existing Atlas doors/types, cumulative prerequisites and minimal integration seam are explicit; no second knowledge store or bypass.
Separate planned, executed, reviewed, accepted, landed and activated states; no blanket PASS from preparation or historical pilot evidence.

layer_package_checks: Every required artifact and dependency of the finite layer is present with exact original and derivative byte identities.
Both judges review the same union and all applicable criteria; complete-layer release requires both applicable PASS and no critical conflict.
Source/intent/inference/gap remain distinguishable; unsupported critical content prevents acceptance.
Each required intermediate answers a frozen need; direct-use consumer proof stays open until real reader execution.
A changed body, source, recipe, authority, contract or dependency receives a new manifest and affected-criterion reassessment.
consumer_package_checks: Freeze task, independent oracle, critical mistakes and task-specific limits before exposing outputs.
Cover allowed maintenance, violation, cross-component impact, operational failure, out-of-scope abstention, shallow/deep use and every required intermediate directly.
Record real ownership.index/read calls and exact returned bytes/sections/versions including misses, truncation and HOLD.
Consumer never receives oracle, authoring prompt or source-discovery tools; disclose any host inability to enforce this.
Exposed historical cases remain regressions; renamed cases do not become held-out.

judge_output_contract.intermediate_request: REQUEST_EVIDENCE with exact criterion, artifact/section and deciding question
judge_output_contract.approval_validation: Coordinator mechanically verifies complete criterion set and input/response binding; no self-reported hash trusted without comparison.
